compliance.summary: The homepage presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering company selling AI measurement and delivery outcomes, rather than the approved staffing and recruiting agency. It also makes unsupported claims about services, performance, clients, client figures, security, contacts, and certifications that should not carry into the rewrite.

llm_problems.fix: Reposition the homepage around the approved company description and its recruiting and staffing services.
